description: This source file defines the Api class within the Setting namespace of the Catalog module in the Opencart project. It provides methods for managing API authentication, session handling, and related operations, indicating it is a core part of the API model logic for catalog settings.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: A model class for handling API authentication, session management, and security within the catalog setting namespace.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates an API user using username and key, returning user data if valid.

methods.name: getApiByToken
methods.description: Retrieves API access details based on a provided token, ensuring session validity.

methods.name: getSessions
methods.description: Retrieves active API sessions for a specified API ID.

methods.name: deleteSessions
methods.description: Deletes (or deactivates) API sessions for a specified API ID.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Keeps an API session alive by updating its last modified timestamp.

methods.name: cleanSessions
methods.description: Removes expired or outdated API sessions from the database.
